Close Vintage Overdrive Sale $109.95 Regular price $179.95 3 available Default Title - $109.95 USD Quantity Add to Cart     With its smooth, round attack, sweet singing-sustain, and gentle compression, the Vintage Overdrive delivers all the "screaming overdrive" you know and love, expanding on the classic with an all-new, unique circuit, offering even more gain and output than the original. These are premium builds using exclusively high-quality, low-noise components and mechanical true-bypass, giving you exceptional tone and drive capabilities, with loads of output available. Housed in a genuine Hammond Manufacturing enclosure, and handmade here in Portland, OR, these pedals are built to last. Jack Deville original design. Basic Features : Sweet, creamy 100%-analog overdrive and boost Classic 3-knob layout Loads of output on-tap Genuine 4558 opamp CNC-milled genuine Hammond enclosure EZ-2-C LED indicator with diffusion lens Made in U.S.A. sources.excerpt: Vintage Overdrive by Mr. Black | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Mr. Black Vintage Overdrive LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS OVERDRIVE Description Designed by Jack Deville, the Vintage Overdrive expands upon the classic green screamer circuit architecture using an authentic 4558 operational amplifier. The circuit delivers smooth pick attack, singing sustain, and subtle natural compression. It is voiced with expanded gain range and substantially increased output volume compared to traditional vintage units. Standard controls provide intuitive adjustment of drive intensity, tone shaping, and master level. Premium low-noise components are utilized throughout alongside mechanical true-bypass switching. Handcrafted in Portland, Oregon, the unit is housed inside a CNC-milled Hammond aluminum enclosure.
